$comment: Prompt fragments shared by every provider. The main agent merges these into data/base/style.json later. Palette source: seed-data/style.json (data/base/style.json once it exists).
suffix: stylized low-poly diorama game asset, chunky readable shapes, warm earthy palette, flat shading, clean silhouette, plain neutral background, no text, no logo
negative: photorealistic, noisy texture, text, watermark, thin spindly parts, modern objects
concept_camera: single object centered in frame, three-quarter front view, soft even light from the upper left, plain flat neutral background, full object visible with margin
mesh_suffix: stylized low-poly game asset, chunky readable shapes, flat colors, clean silhouette, no fine detail
unit_pose: relaxed standing pose, arms slightly away from the body, feet shoulder width apart, never an A-pose or a T-pose, facing the camera
vfx_suffix: on a pure black background, centered, glowing, soft falloff, no text
sfx_template: {subject}, dry, no reverb, close perspective, clean game sound effect
music_template: {subject}, instrumental, warm hand-played folk instruments and soft percussion, loop friendly, no vocals
